content:
Feasible region vertices are  
\[
A=\left(\frac13,\frac13\right),\quad C=\left(k,\frac{1-k}{2}\right),\quad E=(k,k).
\]
Evaluate \(z=x+ky\):
\[
z_A=\frac{1+k}{3},\quad z_C=\frac{k(3-k)}{2},\quad z_E=k(1+k).
\]
For the minimum to be \(-2\), only \(z_C\) can be negative, so
\[
\frac{k(3-k)}{2}=-2 \implies k^2-3k-4=0 \implies k=4.
\]
Then
\[
z_A=\frac53,\quad z_C=-2,\quad z_E=4(5)=20.
\]
Thus the maximum value is
\[
\boxed{20}
\]
